<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion at m/z 198.99966 is interpreted as [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈197.992 Da. The isotopic pattern (M and M+2 of nearly equal intensity) indicates the presence of a single bromine atom (⁷⁹Br/⁸¹Br). Removing the monoisotopic mass of ⁷⁹Br (78.918 Da) leaves 119.074 Da to be accounted for by C, H, and O. The combination C₅H₁₁O₃ matches this residual mass within a few millidaltons, giving a total exact mass of 197.989 Da (≈3 mDa low, acceptable for high‑resolution data). Therefore the molecular formula is C₅H₁₁O₃Br.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H11O3Br</final_answer>
